messages:
Alex M: quick async check-in on kernel/continuous-batching/KV rollups — short status + blockers.
Alex M: TL;DR: batching perf steady, KV cache eviction causing a small regressing latency spike in canary, working on fix. Need owners for L2 eviction tuning + canary observation.
Priya K: where do you see the spike? can you paste the prometheus query or logs? :eyes:
Alex M: prometheus: `sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{le="0.1"}[5m])) by (instance)` showed 3x p95 on one canary node. logs:
```
evictor: evicted 120 keys, watermark=0.87, free=12MB, target=64MB
kvcache: kv_get latency spike at 2025-03-04T10:12:23Z
```
Chris T: I opened PR #4321 (evictor: lower hysteresis, add backoff) — small change, runs fine in unit tests. linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4321 :thumbsup:
Jamal: assign me on the canary watch. i'll roll a smoke script and watch tokenized-throughput + p95 over 30m.
Lin: if eviction is too aggressive it thrashes the KV cache; suggest we try `WATERMARK_LOW=0.6` for the canary first. I'll add a knob in the runtime config.
Alex M: Owners: Chris -> PR, Lin -> runtime knob, Jamal -> canary watch + rollback plan. Priya -> perf dashboard refresh + alert thresholds. infra-bot: Canary deploy started for `evictor-pr-4321` on us-west-2 at 2025-03-04T10:45Z
Priya K: added alert rule `kv_eviction_spike` with 10m window, notify #eng-runtime if p95 > 200ms on more than 2 nodes.
Chris T: rolled patch, CI green. pinging for review: @Lin @Alex M
Lin: quick review done, added config flag `KV_EVICT_WATERMARK_LOW`, updated docs in runtime-config.md
Alex M: plan: roll canary 1 node now, watch 30m. If p95 stabilizes -> roll remainder. If spike persists -> rollback to previous release and we attach logs. Jamal can you run the smoke script now and post results?
Jamal: running now, will post summary in ~20m. quick curl i use:
`curl -sS https://canary-usw2.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .latency`
Chris T: small note: older models have higher prefix cache pressure; this may be unrelated but worth noting.
Alex M: thanks all. if no rollback, we should merge into main tonight and schedule a follow-up on eviction heuristics for next sprint. :calendar:
Jamal: smoke run summary: p95 baseline 120ms -> canary with patch 128ms -> node with previous config 400ms (so patch looks good). no rollback.
Alex M: great. I'll close this check-in. action items: Chris PR -> merge; Lin open runtime config PR; Priya confirm alerting saved; Jamal monitor for 24h. :white_check_mark:
